parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle of the suitcase, made of durable plastic and ergonomically shaped for carrying.
parts.Functional_description: The handle allows the user to lift and carry the suitcase comfortably.
parts.Movement_description: It may pivot slightly or remain fixed depending on the design, but it does not move independently during normal use.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of the suitcase, made of polycarbonate for impact resistance and lightweight durability.
parts.Functional_description: The lid covers and protects the contents of the suitcase when closed and locks securely with the base body.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a hinge to open and close the suitcase.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main compartment or base body of the suitcase, made of polycarbonate for strength and rigidity.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the contents of the suitcase and provides structural support for the lid and handle.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the foundation to which the lid is attached via hinges.
